league_wrap.title: Camp Desk — Sunday, Aug 30
league_wrap.bottom_line: Cutdown Sunday set the 53-man shelves and moved several Week 1 pictures. Named IR and exempt-list absences matter; trade chatter without a second source does not. Thin camp info stays Pass.
storylines: Packers: Josh Jacobs is on the commissioner's exempt list (league announcement) and cannot practice or play while the case proceeds. Green Bay traded for Steelers RB Kaleb Johnson the same day — depth insurance, not a starter crown for Lloyd or Brooks.
Giants: Calvin Austin III is on season-ending IR with a torn ACL (club confirmation Aug 27). Slot work defaults to Berrios and a thinner WR room; do not invent a WR2 from preseason snaps.

Dolphins / Jaguars: Miami traded Quinn Ewers to Jacksonville (2028 sixth), then acquired Kyle McCord from Green Bay for a 2028 sixth. Willis remains the named Miami starter; McCord is backup math. Jacksonville added QB depth, not a Week 1 starter rewrite.

Cowboys / Steelers: Dallas acquired OT Broderick Jones (and a 2027 fourth) for 2027 third- and sixth-round picks (AP / club). Jones is swing-tackle depth and RT competition with Steele — Pass on crowning a new starter from the trade alone.
League-wide: every club must be at 53 by 6 p.m. ET. Final practice-squad and claim chatter will keep moving Monday; treat Sunday cut lists as the first shelf, not a futures lean.

Carry-forward depth: Watson is Cleveland's named Week 1 starter; Atlanta's Penix–Tagovailoa split still needs a formal Week 1 call; Higgins (HOU) and Pinter (BAL) remain season-ending OL/WR hits from last week.
league_wrap.what_to_watch: Monday's initial 53 lists and practice-squad claims; any formal Week 1 starter language in Atlanta; Packers RB practice plan with Jacobs unavailable; Cowboys tackle snap share after Jones clears.

team_notes.title: Packers camp — Aug 30
team_notes.bottom_line: Jacobs is unavailable on the commissioner's exempt list, and Green Bay added Kaleb Johnson for backfield depth. Lloyd and Brooks remain the in-house plan; Pass on crowning a Week 1 RB1 from the trade.
key_points: The league placed Jacobs on the commissioner's exempt list Sunday — paid leave, no practice, no games while legal and NFL processes continue.
Green Bay traded for Steelers RB Kaleb Johnson on cutdown day (ESPN/TSN). Pierre Strong Jr. is not expected to make the 53 after the deal.
MarShawn Lloyd and Chris Brooks were already the next names behind Jacobs. Johnson is depth insurance, not a starter declaration.
team_notes.what_to_watch: Who takes first-team RB work in Week 1 prep with Jacobs out, and whether the club posts an updated depth chart.
team_notes.sot_flag: Jacobs unavailable (exempt list); Johnson added. Flag Packers RB depth — do not invent a Week 1 starter from camp prose.

team_notes.title: Giants camp — Aug 30
team_notes.bottom_line: Austin's season is over on IR (torn ACL). Slot depth thins to Berrios and a committee; Pass on naming a replacement WR2 from cutdown noise.
key_points: Giants.com confirmed Austin on injured reserve Aug 27 after a torn ACL in the Aug 25 practice — season-ending.
Braxton Berrios is the next slot name in beat reporting; Odell Beckham Jr. and tight-end packages can absorb snaps. Roles are unset.
Cutdown day still shuffles the final WR and special-teams edges; do not treat one release as a futures rewrite.
team_notes.what_to_watch: Unofficial Week 1 WR depth chart and who returns punts with Austin gone.
team_notes.sot_flag: Austin season-ending IR. Flag Giants WR/slot depth — do not invent a replacement starter.

team_notes.title: Dolphins camp — Aug 30
team_notes.bottom_line: Ewers is gone to Jacksonville; McCord arrives as Willis' backup. Named starter is still Willis. Pass on inventing a QB controversy from cutdown trades.
key_points: Miami traded Quinn Ewers to the Jaguars for a 2028 sixth-round pick (club confirmation on the Jacksonville side).
On Sunday the Dolphins acquired Kyle McCord from Green Bay for a 2028 sixth — Schefter/ESPN — after releasing Cam Miller and Mark Gronowski.
Hafley has signaled a likely two-QB 53. McCord is depth behind Willis, not a starter claim.
team_notes.what_to_watch: Final 53 QB count and any practice-squad reclaim language for cut passers.
team_notes.sot_flag: Ewers traded out; McCord in as QB2 depth. Do not change Miami QB1 from Willis without a club statement.

team_notes.title: Jaguars camp — Aug 30
team_notes.bottom_line: Jacksonville added Quinn Ewers for QB depth and released veteran Nick Mullens in the same cutdown window. Pass on reading a starter change into the trade.
key_points: Official: Jaguars acquire Ewers from Miami for a 2028 sixth-round pick, pending physical.
Multiple reports (NFL Network / Schefter) had Jacksonville releasing Nick Mullens as the 53 took shape — veteran backup math, not a Trevor Lawrence story.
Ewers gives Coen a developmental/backup body after Miami's camp sample. Week 1 QB1 remains Lawrence unless the club says otherwise.
team_notes.what_to_watch: Who is listed QB2 on the first posted 53 and any practice-squad QB reclaim.
team_notes.sot_flag: Ewers added; Mullens reportedly released. Flag JAX QB depth only — do not invent a starter change.

team_notes.title: Cowboys camp — Aug 30
team_notes.bottom_line: Dallas added Broderick Jones for tackle depth and RT competition. Steele / Guyton jobs are not settled by the trade alone. Pass.
key_points: Cowboys.com and AP: Dallas sends 2027 third- and sixth-round picks to Pittsburgh for Jones and a 2027 fourth.
Jones, a 2023 first-rounder returning from 2025 neck surgery, projects as swing tackle and possible Steele competition — not an automatic Week 1 starter.
Cutdown still decides how many tackles Dallas carries; one trade does not rewrite the OL SoT.
team_notes.what_to_watch: First 53 OL count and who takes RT ones in Week 1 prep after Jones clears.
team_notes.sot_flag: Jones acquired. Flag Cowboys OT depth / RT competition — do not invent a starter from the trade.

team_notes.title: Steelers camp — Aug 30
team_notes.bottom_line: Pittsburgh moved Broderick Jones to Dallas and Kaleb Johnson to Green Bay on the cutdown window. Tackle and RB depth thins; Pass on inventing new starters from the exits.
key_points: Jones and a 2027 fourth went to Dallas for third- and sixth-round picks (AP / Cowboys). Fautanu / Cook / Iheanachor remain the in-house tackle picture.
Kaleb Johnson was traded to Green Bay (ESPN/TSN) as Packers RB depth behind an unavailable Jacobs — Pittsburgh sheds a low-usage second-year back.
Those are depth exits on deadline day. Do not crown Iheanachor or a new RB2 from the transactions alone.
team_notes.what_to_watch: Posted 53 OT and RB counts after claims settle Monday.
team_notes.sot_flag: Jones and Johnson traded out. Flag Steelers OT/RB depth — no invented starters.
